arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the model (onnx), empty for PP-ResNet50 of opencv_zoo, e.g. MobileNet of opencv_zoo (OpenCV 4.9 or later)

arg.name: classes
arg.description: Path or URL of the class names of the model, one class per line, or empty for the 1000 classes of ImageNet

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: top_k
arg.description: Number of the classes to publish

arg.name: softmax
arg.description: Apply softmax to the output of the model to get the probabilities, true for the models whose output is the logits (e.g. PP-ResNet50 and MobileNet of opencv_zoo), false for the models whose output is the probabilities
